records.researcher_notes: The Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality posted a public notice dated September 9, 2026. The JAN250 Site at 1001 Industrial Park Drive in Clinton, Hinds County, asked for an optional pre-permit construction approval for a data center. The data center would have emergency back-up generators with a total power capacity of approximately 250 megawatts and diesel fuel storage tanks. The notice does not name the company. The state air permit database page for the same address lists the facility as Amazon Data Services, with air construction permit file 1080-00275 and a comment period that ended on September 21, 2026. I did not find the draft permit itself. Guessed document addresses failed, and the saved copies of the public notice page on the Wayback Machine do not include this notice. The point is a street search result for Industrial Park Drive in Clinton and is approximate. The Census geocoder placed a different road name about 2 kilometers away, so I did not use it. Not found: the number of generators, the size of each, the start year and the exact site.
